text:
Type: bench
Name: Pinzon TV Bench, Espresso
Colors: Brown
Solid, efficiently sized TV bench is great for urban living spaces; use for AV equipment or as a gorgeous shelf/bookcase Top and front frame moldings made of solid, 2-inch-thick Scandinavian pine; sides and bottom made of foiled particleboard 2 open storage spaces for AV equipment or media; shelf is adjustable; discreet opening in back for wiring and cables Expertly made in Denmark and finished in a choice of colors; some easy assembly required Measures 37.4 inches wide by 14 inches deep by 19.7 inches high; approximately 27 pounds
